shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"weather|inputSchema|validation|tool result|additional|defensive|missing input\" README.md docs/adding-a-tool.md .specify/spec.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md CHANGELOG.md example/weather-tool.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix validator cache test assertion" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
